usage: SelectCandidates.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] --split_folder
                           SPLIT_FOLDER --pileup_vcf_fn PILEUP_VCF_FN
                           [--ref_fn REF_FN] [--var_pct_full VAR_PCT_FULL]
                           [--ref_pct_full REF_PCT_FULL] [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                           [--samtools SAMTOOLS]
                           [--call_low_seq_entropy CALL_LOW_SEQ_ENTROPY]
                           [--seq_entropy_pro SEQ_ENTROPY_PRO]
                           [--split_bed_size SPLIT_BED_SIZE]
                           [--phasing_info_in_bam]

Select pileup candidates for full alignment

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --split_folder SPLIT_FOLDER
                        Path to directory that stores candidate region,
                        required
  --pileup_vcf_fn PILEUP_VCF_FN
                        Input pileup pileup vcf, required
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input, required
  --var_pct_full VAR_PCT_FULL
                        Specify an expected percentage of low quality 0/1 and
                        1/1 variants called in the pileup mode for full-
                        alignment mode calling, default: 0.300000
  --ref_pct_full REF_PCT_FULL
                        Specify an expected percentage of low quality 0/0
                        variants called in the pileup mode for full-alignment
                        mode calling, default: 0.300000
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed
  --samtools SAMTOOLS   Path to the 'samtools', samtools version >= 1.10 is
                        required, default: samtools
  --call_low_seq_entropy CALL_LOW_SEQ_ENTROPY
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable full alignment calling on
                        candidate variants with low sequence entropy
  --seq_entropy_pro SEQ_ENTROPY_PRO
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Define the percentage of the candidate
                        variants with the lowest sequence entropy for full
                        alignment calling, default: 0.050000
  --split_bed_size SPLIT_BED_SIZE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Define the candidate bed size for each
                        split bed file. default: 10000
  --phasing_info_in_bam
                        DEBUG: Skip phasing and use the phasing info provided
                        in the input BAM (HP tag), default: True
